target_customer: Specialty and commercial contractors, including firms doing prevailing wage and certified payroll work
problem: Generic payroll providers do not handle construction payroll rules such as multi rate, union and prevailing wage payroll, and contractors juggle several tools.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription covering payroll, time tracking and HR

founders.name: Brek Goin
founders.background_notes: Per launch post built one of the largest construction media outlets with 500 million organic impressions in 2022

founders.name: Sanket Firodiya
founders.background_notes: Founding engineer at Superhuman per YC page

technical_complexity.rationale: Payroll with tax filing, prevailing wage and certified payroll rules plus accounting integrations is moderately hard for a small team.

defensibility.rationale: Payroll is sticky once adopted and construction rules add complexity, but Rippling and ADP serve contractors too.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Later a rival, Trayd, raised a 4.5M seed in Feb 2025 and 10M in March 2026 per press; no incumbent shut the wedge.

market_need_then: Contractors complained about generic payroll tools; the first five customers signed from Figma mockups per the YC launch post.

branding.domain_note: hammr.com, exact match for the vowel dropped spelling

identity.logo: not confirmed; a similar HAMMR trademark in a search result may belong to another entity
identity.voice_and_tone: Direct and practical, an extension on your team

branding.community_and_virality: Founder hosts or appears on construction podcasts (Bred To Build per site, a guest on The Mobilization Mindset); CEO built a construction media audience.

brand_strength.rationale: Name evokes a hammer which suits construction, helped by founder's media audience, but limited independent coverage.

pivots.to: Construction payroll, HR and operations platform
pivots.why: Customer feedback per the YC page; exact date not given

outcome_analysis: Hammr pivoted from a construction labor marketplace to payroll and HR after customer feedback and now lists enterprise style customers and Sage Intacct Marketplace presence. Public funding is unknown with only aggregator estimates, and team size stayed around 10, so scale is unclear. Rival Trayd raised more recently.
notes: Unverified aggregator funding: about 530K over several rounds (one aggregator) and 1.03M (Caplight) with investors Y Combinator, Great Wave Ventures, Broom Ventures, Avalanche VC; none confirmed by a press release or company source, so no rounds recorded. No dated competitor sources found for 2023. HQ listed as Seattle by CB Insights, San Francisco by YC. Education not found.
